full_name: William Hurst | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: William Hurst, an associate professor in the Department of Political Science at Northwestern University, focuses mainly on Chinese and Indonesian politics, especially the politics of courts and legal institutions, labor politics, contentious politics, and political economy.
